beginner.title: Get started with Google Family Link
beginner.outcome: You can: set up Google Family Link, find your way around and finish a first small task
beginner.practice: Complete the official getting-started guide, then one small real task from your work

beginner.title: Set up for your family
beginner.outcome: You can: set up Google Family Link for your household
beginner.practice: Set up Google Family Link for one child or family member

beginner.title: Daily rhythm
beginner.outcome: You can: use Google Family Link in daily family life
beginner.practice: Agree one family routine in Google Family Link

intermediate.title: Rules and limits
intermediate.practice: Agree and set three rules together

intermediate.title: Talk about it
intermediate.outcome: You can: build trust, not just controls
intermediate.practice: Have one conversation about online safety

intermediate.title: Signature skills in Google Family Link
intermediate.outcome: You can: use the features that make Google Family Link distinctive
intermediate.practice: Use each of these features once on a real piece of work

expert.title: Advanced Google Family Link
expert.outcome: You can: use Google Family Link's advanced capabilities with confidence
expert.practice: Complete a project that needs at least two of these advanced capabilities

expert.title: Review and adapt
expert.outcome: You can: adjust as children grow

expert.title: Integrate Google Family Link into your workflow
expert.outcome: You can: connect Google Family Link with the other tools you use
expert.practice: Connect Google Family Link to one other tool you use and remove one manual step

expert.title: Lead and teach others
expert.outcome: You can: set standards and teach others to use Google Family Link well
expert.practice: Write a one-page "how we use Google Family Link" guide and teach it to one person

expert_validation.note: Generated from the archetype template plus tool-specific signature skills; to be reviewed by a practitioner.
